rule: A class of docs/defect-ledger.jsonl with `threshold` or more entries has a guard: a test that runs every tool and fails wherever the class shows, so a fix of one tool is not the end of a class that keeps coming back. revert_proof.py refuses a fix whose class is due and has no guard (`pending`), and tests/test_guards.py fails when a class becomes due without being listed here.

time.how: emit.source_carry says chapters_not_retimed for any output of another length whose chapters were carried by a tool that declared no time map (runner.with_mapped_chapters, runner.declare_time_map)

claim.how: every tool and the multi-input ones run on a 16:9, 5.1, chaptered, subtitled clip; fewer channels, or a frame that keeps or fills less than half of the picture, with no warning or source_carry entry saying it, fails

not_measured.how: a dry run of every tool reports no probe, wrote, verified or output measurement; no record with file: null carries a true/false about that file

surface.how: the picture is stream 0 of every output that has one, and a result that wrote media starts with status and wrote

automation.how: every tool, started with an open and silent stdin, ends and answers

color.how: every tool that writes video, and export's youtube and prores presets, grid and join by hand, run on an HDR RGB source; an output whose matrix, primaries and transfer mix SDR and HDR names fails. The matrix the pixels were made with (#559's form) is pinned by the HdrRgbSourceTests pixel readback, not by this guard
